create_habitat_env: create a Habitat Env instance with a DictConfig and optional dataset for embodied AI simulation
reset_env_episode: reset the Env to start a new episode and return initial observations from the simulator
step_env_action: step the Env with an action dict or action name to get observations and update measurements
create_rl_env: create an RLEnv subclass with custom get_reward, get_done, and get_info methods for reinforcement learning
step_rl_env: step the RLEnv with an action to return observations, reward, done flag, and info dict
